title: New in Symfony 8.2: ObjectMapper Improvements
content:
<html><head></head><body>The ObjectMapper component copies data between objects, such as DTOs and
entities, based on #[Map] attributes. It was introduced in Symfony 7.3
and improved in Symfony 8.1. Symfony 8.2 removes more of the glue code that
you still had to write for common cases…</body></html>
author: Javier Eguiluz
